metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2013 · Frozen
metas.description: Fearless optimist Anna teams up with rugged mountain man Kristoff and his loyal reindeer Sven in an epic journey to find Anna's sister Elsa, whose icy powers have trapped the kingdom of Arendelle in eternal winter.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Brave
metas.description: Determined to make her own path in life, Princess Merida defies a custom that brings chaos to her kingdom. Granted one wish, Merida must rely on her bravery and her archery skills to undo a beastly curse.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2013 · Despicable Me 2
metas.description: When a new criminal comes to town, the Anti-Villain League decides to hire Gru in order to fight him off. While Gru initially refuses, he eventually agrees after his aide goes back to his evil ways.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2013 · Monsters University
metas.description: A look at the relationship between Mike Wazowski and James P. "Sully" Sullivan during their days at Monsters University, when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2011 · Kung Fu Panda 2
metas.description: Po and his friends fight to stop a peacock villain from conquering China with a deadly new weapon, but first the Dragon Warrior must come to terms with his past.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2010 · Megamind
metas.description: Evil genius Megamind finally defeats his do-gooder nemesis, Metro Man, but is left without a purpose in a superhero-free world.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2011 · Rango
metas.description: Rango is an ordinary chameleon who accidentally winds up in the town of Dirt, a lawless outpost in the Wild West in desperate need of a new sheriff.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2011 · The Adventures of Tintin
metas.description: Intrepid reporter Tintin and Captain Haddock set off on a treasure hunt for a sunken ship commanded by Haddock's ancestor.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · The Croods
metas.description: In the primeval era, Grug and his family risk the dangers of their surroundings to find a new dwelling place. Along the way, they meet a modern boy who woos them with his adventurous ways.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: When the evil spirit Pitch launches an assault on Earth, the Immortal Guardians team up to protect the innocence of children all around the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · ParaNorman
metas.description: A misunderstood boy takes on ghosts, zombies and grown-ups to save his town from a centuries-old curse.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2014 · The Book of Life
metas.description: Manolo, a young man who is torn between fulfilling the expectations of his family and following his heart, embarks on an adventure that spans three fantastic worlds where he must face his greatest fears.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2011 · Arthur Christmas
metas.description: Santa's clumsy son Arthur sets out on a mission with Grandsanta to give out a misplaced present to a young girl in less than two hours on Christmas Day.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2013 · The Garden of Words
metas.description: On a rainy morning in Tokyo, 15-year-old Takao, an aspiring shoemaker, decides to skip class to sketch designs in a beautiful garden. This is where he meets Yukari, a beautiful yet mysterious woman. They strike an unlikely friends...

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2011 · From Up on Poppy Hill
metas.description: A group of Yokohama teens look to save their school's clubhouse from the wrecking ball in preparations for the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2010 · The Illusionist
metas.description: A French illusionist finds himself out of work and travels to Scotland, where he meets a young woman. Their ensuing adventure changes both their lives forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
metas.description: After sleeping for 39 years, the God of destruction Beerus is surprised to learn that Frieza was defeated by the saiyajin Goku. Upon finding him, Goku is excited to face him, but realizes that his powers are negligible compared to...

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2011 · Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: While searching for honey, Pooh and his friends embark on an adventure to find Eeyore's missing tail and rescue Christopher Robin from an unknown monster called The Backson.
